files.README.md:
# catalog-api

REST API generated by [Model2API](https://raulesteveza.github.io/tools/Model2API/) with ASP.NET Core. It is a starting point: review it before using it in production.

## Run it

Requires the .NET 10 SDK.

```bash
dotnet run --project src/CatalogApi
```

Settings are read from `src/CatalogApi/appsettings.json` and, above it, from environment variables with the same names: `DATABASE_CONNECTION` (the connection string), `API_KEYS`. Never commit real values.

The API listens on http://localhost:5000. Its contract is in `openapi.yaml`.

## Test it

```bash
dotnet test
```

Each test starts the application anew, so it starts with empty storage.
The tests use a new SQLite file for each test, or the mariadb database in `TEST_DATABASE_CONNECTION` (a connection string to a database only for tests: each test deletes and creates it again).

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | What it does | Success | Access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/categories` | List categories | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/categories/{id}` | Get a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/categories` | Create a category | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/categories/{id}` | Replace a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/categories/{id}` | Update part of a category | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/categories/{id}` | Delete a category | 204 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/items` | List items | 200 | authenticated |
| `GET` | `/items/{id}` | Get an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `POST` | `/items` | Create an item | 201 | authenticated |
| `PUT` | `/items/{id}` | Replace an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `PATCH` | `/items/{id}` | Update part of an item | 200 | authenticated |
| `DELETE` | `/items/{id}` | Delete an item | 204 | authenticated |

Errors always have the same body: `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "details": [...]}}`. Invalid requests answer 400.

## Storage

Entity Framework Core on mariadb. The application creates the tables when the database has none (`EnsureCreated`); for a real database, use migrations (`dotnet ef migrations add Initial`, or Model2DB). Embedded objects and lists are stored as JSON columns, and references as key columns.

## Authentication

Protected endpoints need a key in the `X-API-Key` header, one of the comma-separated keys in `API_KEYS`. Without `API_KEYS`, every protected request is rejected.

## Structure

```text
src/CatalogApi/
  Common/              errors, lists, request bodies and JSON helpers
  Models/              domain classes, enums and embedded objects
  Dtos/                request bodies and responses
  Repositories/        storage
  Services/            rules of each resource
  Controllers/         HTTP routes
  Data/                the database context
  Security/            authentication
tests/CatalogApi.Tests/    one test class per resource
openapi.yaml             the contract of the API
```

## Left to you

- Nothing marked: review the generated code before using it.
